snippet.title: Biped 2 Release Trailer | All platforms
snippet.description: Biped 2, a sequel to the highly praised co-op adventure beloved by players worldwide. is now available on Steam, GOG, and the Epic Games Store, as well as on PlayStation 4 and 5, Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, and Series X|S. A cross-platform online COOP for up to 4 players is waiting for you. Take it on your platform and play with your friends and family on any other platform online.
